scientific_integrity: The proof separates the necessary congruence, a published digit-sum progression theorem, and an independent block-concatenation argument. The infinite assertion does not rely on finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The explicit threshold \(T\) is an upper bound for the eventual-spectrum conductor and need not be optimal; the theorem does not classify the finite exceptional admissible digit sums below \(T\).
title: The attainable digit sums of multiples are eventually one congruence class
